systemsRead: Supabase aggregate payment and recorded-attribution evidence
scope.privacy: No identifiers, credentials, patient rows, clinical answers, free text, query strings, referrers or click IDs are persisted. Only aggregate counts/cash and whitelisted public pathnames are present.

methodology.cashAccounting: Canonical readCustomerGrowthRevenueEvidence plus buildCustomerGrowthRevenueForIntakeIds/buildNetRetainedPurchaseValue. Purchases enter by paid_at; exact live-AUD refund/dispute cash events leave or return in their own windows; reportable and seeded-E2E exclusions are inherited from the reader.
methodology.serviceJoin: Identifiers were used only in memory to attach canonical cash events to category/subtype cohorts, recorded acquisition source and entry pathname. They were not logged or written.
methodology.serviceSeparation: Landing pathname never determines purchased service. Every landing/channel row states the separately recorded purchased service.
methodology.sourceClassification: Canonical classifyAttributionSource; Google/Bing organic are separated only when a recorded exact UTM source or search-referrer host supports the provider. AI provider uses exact classifyAiSource evidence.
methodology.organicIntentBoundary: No organic brand/non-brand row is presented as an observed query split. GSC query text is omitted.
methodology.createdIntakes: Created-intake counts use created_at cohorts and are shown separately from paid_at order counts. No conversion rate is calculated.
methodology.search: Existing 2026-09-05 GSC intent receipt provides final page totals; existing URL Inspection baseline provides index status and last-crawl time. GSC and financial periods remain separate.

limitations: Search Console suppresses/anonymises query and dimension rows. Page totals are authoritative for page performance and are intentionally kept separate from query, country and device rows, which may not sum to them.
Low-volume query samples cannot establish stable intent ownership or conversion impact. Null percent deltas mean the prior value was zero.
Average position is an impression-weighted aggregate, not a fixed rank. Positive deltas in average-position numeric value mean worse position.
URL Inspection status comes from the separate 2026-09-05 baseline receipt and is not a Live Test rendered proof.
Current public HTML was fetched before the separately owned crawl/schema release and before the parent child-page wording change; post-release verification belongs to the coordinating task.
Search-result sampling establishes result type and vocabulary only. It is not search volume, rank tracking, market-share or competitor-claim substantiation.
General antibiotics articles were excluded as growth targets. No external publisher, directory, prospect, backlink or outreach work was performed.

annotations.note: Certificate verification work is recorded as shipped August 24 in the canonical plan addendum; exact production time is not established here. Preserve its two-window readout and do not shift its boundary to August 25.
Repeat-prescription answer-density release opened its longer measurement windows; this receipt does not reset them.
ED E1 and Hair H1 product cohorts opened. The current financial and GSC periods overlap this release, so changes are not attributable to it.
Approved Scripts Ads budget step occurred near the end of the current financial period; this scorecard does not attribute period growth to SEO.
GSC/index receipts captured. Crawl/schema release remains separately owned; UTI/pill wording edits and post-release proof are outside this receipt.

reasons: Current closed-period paid orders and net-retained cash are materially higher, but paid acquisition, product experiments and releases overlap the comparison.
Search clicks remain tiny relative to impressions; prescription and UTI routes lack measurable GSC visibility, and indexing/crawl gaps remain recorded.
Fees, acquisition cost, retained-order count and a session-to-order join are unavailable, so service contribution and funnel success cannot be claimed.
decision.nextEvidence: Recheck prescription and UTI crawl/index status after the separately owned release, preserve the open certificate/repeat-Rx and ED/Hair windows, and compare mature closed cohorts before commissioning another page change.
